questions.prompt: Which ancient wonder was a statue of Zeus?
questions.fact: It was around twelve metres tall and seated, so a standing figure would have burst through the temple roof.

questions.prompt: What is the term for organisms living in extreme environments?
questions.fact: Some survive inside nuclear reactors, and their enzymes made routine DNA testing possible.

questions.prompt: How many minutes does a rugby union match last?
questions.fact: Play continues past the whistle until the ball goes dead, so halves regularly run over.

questions.prompt: Which television programme features a blue police box?
questions.fact: The box was meant to change appearance each episode, and the mechanism was written as broken to save money.

questions.prompt: Which sea lies west of Denmark?
questions.fact: Its shallow depth and storm surges are why the Netherlands built such extensive flood defences.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel One Day in the Life of Ivan Denisovich?
questions.fact: It was published with Khrushchev's personal approval, and its author was expelled from the country twelve years later.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym ETL describe in data work?
questions.fact: A newer variant reverses the last two steps, loading raw data first and transforming it inside the warehouse.
